description: Extract invoice number, date, total and VAT from invoice text and deliver a reconciliation CSV. When invoices arrive as text and need structuring for reconciliation. Do not choose this when the source is a PDF or scan, which needs OCR. Example requests: Extract the totals from these invoices. | Turn this invoice text into structured records. | Parse these invoices into a reconciliation file.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

invoice.description: The customer's invoices.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text. One or more invoices, blocks separated by blank lines. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_invoice_data_extraction
title: Invoice data extraction
